titulo: Before you say “I’ll just do it myself”: 3 checks
caption:
Before you say “I’ll just do it myself”: 3 checks. Save it for the next time you are about to do it all. Cella asked first.
Link in bio.
by NMR
#delegate #relatable #cella

alt.1: Cella with a crown under a spotlight, large. Save · 3 checks. Before you say “I’ll just do it myself” 3 checks first.
alt.2: a big number 1 and a small Cella in the corner. Check 1. Is it really faster? Today, yes. Next month, you’re still doing it.
alt.3: a big number 2 and a small Cella in the corner. Check 2. Will you resent it by 4 PM? If yes, you already know the answer.
alt.4: a big number 3 and a small Cella in the corner. Check 3. Did you ask out loud? A hint is not a request.
alt.5: a numbered list and a small Cella in the corner. Save this. Before you do it all yourself. Send it to someone who does it all. Choose friction. 1. Ask once, out loud. 2. Name the deadline. 3. Let it be done differently.
